content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Electric and gas utility under regulated rates, not a propane distributor with appliances and tank services."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Primarily a regulated gas and electric utility; propane is a secondary line, not its core business."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Industrial MRO products and pump repair for plants, not residential or farm propane delivery."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Plumbing, HVAC and waterworks distribution to contractors and municipalities, not fuel delivery to households."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Refrigerant sales and reclamation to HVAC contractors and facilities, not fuel delivery to homes."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Supermarket and fuel retail to households, with real estate leasing; no propane distribution."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Natural gas compressor rental and fabrication for oil and gas producers, not consumer fuel distribution."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Regulated pipeline natural gas utility in New Jersey; no propane delivery or tank rental business."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Regulated natural gas pipeline distribution utility with no propane, cylinders or appliance services."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Oil refiner and wholesale and retail motor fuel seller, with refining as the core business."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Mainly a regulated natural gas utility; its propane delivery is a minor add-on to pipeline gas."},{"label":"C12","good":true,"reason":"Propane distributor delivering by truck to homes, farms and businesses, with tank rental and appliance service."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Regulated electric generation and transmission utility in New Mexico and Texas; no propane business."}]}
